info.description: Authentication and authorisation service for the ASI platform. Host is determined at runtime via config.API_HOST.
info.title: ASI Auth Service API

post.description: Super admins with Impersonation CREATE permission can impersonate users belonging to a property. Returns an impersonation token (30-min TTL).
Ends the active impersonation session and returns a new admin token. Requires impersonation token in X-token header or token cookie.
post.summary: Stop impersonating and return to admin session

get.description: Returns the current impersonation session if the token is an impersonation token, otherwise null.

post.description: Only super admins can invite other super admins. Requires authentication.

get.description: Paginated super admins with optional search, status filter, sort. Requires super admin and System User Management READ.

parameters.description: Sort field: fullName, username, email, title, status, lastLogin
parameters.name: sortBy

parameters.description: Substring match on full name, username, or email
parameters.name: searchKey

parameters.description: One value or comma-separated: active, deactivated, invitation expired, pending activation
parameters.name: status

get.description: Returns profile and account fields for a super admin. Requires super admin and System User Management READ.
get.summary: Get super admin by user ID

delete.description: Only the primary super admin may remove invited super admins. Soft-deletes the user (IsDeleted), invalidates pending SA invites, and clears global UserRoles. Login and invite links no longer work for that account.

post.description: Any super admin may resend the invite for an invited super admin in Pending Activation (invalidates the previous token) or Invitation Expired. Not allowed for active, deactivated, or primary super admin accounts.
Only users with global UserRoles PropertyRoleID 1 (primary super admin) may call this. Target must be an inactive user with global super admin assignment and super admin role.
Only users with global UserRoles PropertyRoleID 1 (primary super admin) may call this. Target must have PropertyRoleID 2 (invited super admin).

get.description: Returns a list of user sessions for the authenticated user.
Returns a list of user sessions for the authenticated user.

put.summary: Create Property Roles for given propertyID

get.summary: Returns a User for the property id

delete.description: Remove access for user from property

get.summary: Returns a roles entry by property id
Get preset roles for a given property
Reassign a new role to user

get.summary: Returns a system role ID by name
Returns a role entry by ID

delete.description: Deletes a role with the specified ID

patch.description: Reset a role with the specified ID

post.summary: Accept terms and condition for a user

get.summary: Find and return a user by fieldName and value

post.summary: Create or Get User for invite

patch.summary: Update a user by fieldName and value

get.description: Returns true if phone number exists, false otherwise

post.description: Saves partial data for the user

status.description: Status is one of: Active, Deactivated, Invitation Expired, Pending Activation

token.description: Token is the full session JWT when type is 2fa; used when the browser cannot store the dev/qa cookie (e.g. localhost).
